verdict.rationale: Docs and SDK examples (wrap_openai) confirm capturing full traces with inputs/outputs, and dashboards explicitly track token usage, latency, and error rates; OpenTelemetry support extends this beyond native SDKs. Community feedback corroborates seeing full input/output traces per step, though one user notes it mainly captures LLM inferences and integration with non-LangChain frameworks (e.g., CrewAI) is weaker. missing for 10: independent benchmark of latency/token accuracy, broader non-LangChain framework validation.
